licenses.text:
Baibala Hemolele, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/haw1868/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/haw1868/copyright.htm):
> The Holy Bible in the Hawaiian language of the United States, 1868 revision
> Public Domain
> Language: 'Olelo Hawai'i (Hawaiian)
> Translation by: na na misionari i pai
> 2015-11-10

Why this is public domain:
Text: the 1868 revision of the Hawaiian Bible; the 1908 American Bible Society reprint's title page says it was "newly revised" and names no reviser. Translators of the earlier text: Hiram Bingham I 1789-1869, Asa Thurston 1787-1868, Lorrin Andrews 1795-1868, Sheldon Dibble 1809-1845, Artemas Bishop 1795-1872, Ephraim Weston Clark 1799-1878. eBible's text has no ʻokina or kahakō, so it is not the 2018 re-edition. US origin: published in 1868, before 1931. The maintainer's rule (2026-10-16): a text revised by an unnamed committee or reviser and published before 1926 is an anonymous work, in the public domain everywhere.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=haw1868), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/haw1868/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bible_translations_into_the_languages_of_Hawaii; https://archive.org/details/kabaibalahemolel00bibl; Wikidata Q497096, Q18921120, Q14981692, Q7493478, Q61722005, Q19359553; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-haw1868-823891db, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
